name: 学びの達成バッジの横並び
prompt:
Create a faithful 390 × 260 px Japanese horizontal achievement-badge component. Reference 1 is the authoritative native preview for exact geometry, wording and visible crop. References 2–4 are the original badge artwork. Reference 5 shows the approved white and forest-green accent treatment. Return only the component canvas, without phone frame or surrounding app page.

The user dislikes tint colors. Keep the full canvas and all interface/background surfaces pure white #FFFFFF. The source badge rasters have a pale cream square matte outside the circular medals; replace only that flat square matte with pure white. Preserve the circular medal illustrations, gray clouds/ribbons/question marks and blue progress arcs, without redrawing, recoloring or changing their geometry. No cream, mint, pale-green, blush, gray or blue-tinted surface fills; no gradients, shadows, glows or textures. The original blue progress arc stays only as part of the badge artwork.

Match the native 390×260 component: heading x=16/y=8, 358×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28, #1D1D1D, exact text “これまでの達成”. Below it, a horizontally clipped row of three 168×168 badge images at y=58: first image x=-88, second x=96, third x=280. Keep the same visible left and right clipping as the native preview. The cream square outside each medal circle must be white; keep the circular badge artwork intact and centered.

Labels are Meiryo Regular 12/16, #1D1D1D, y=234: first x=0 width168 “一週間の学び”; second x=96 width168 “二週間の学び”; third x=280 width94 “説明する力”. Keep the exact whitespace, three-item spacing and crop from Reference 1. Add no cards, borders, tinted tiles, buttons or extra content.

Use a flat white canvas only. Preserve exact Japanese wording and the original gray badge illustrations with their blue progress accents. The visible cream outside the circular art is a background matte and should be white in this version. Return only the component.
reviewNotes: Outer cream matte removed; pale-gray medal interiors still tint the badge fields; one correction will whiten the fields and preserve neutral art.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
